one_m_decision.rule: signed D2: run 1M only if 100K has NOT hit a budget
one_m_decision.reason: 100K already breached two signed/recorded budgets on this box: concurrent+steady recall latency (warm p95 1202.8ms, concurrent p95 in the same band — the signed p95<=150ms gate fails by ~8x) and RSS (peak 3.94GB vs the 1.5GB service-side 10K ceiling, ~2.6x). Ingest alone took 1374s for 99K rows; a 1M run would need ~4h wall + roughly an order of magnitude more payload RAM. Grinding it out would only re-confirm a ceiling already measured, which the spec explicitly says not to do ('Stop som khi gap ceiling').
one_m_decision.envelope_note: vector/payload storage scales with N; this run does NOT establish a scaling law — it establishes that the local envelope is already exceeded at 100K on this hardware class.
